name: MMO Games
freeEvidence: Official MMO API is available to everyone free without restrictions provided MMOBomb.com is attributed; avoid more than four requests per second.

name: ITIS
freeEvidence: Official ITIS data and database are CC0 public-domain; citation is requested. Public JSON webservice is keyless. Third-party copyrighted site material remains separate.

name: Callook.info
freeEvidence: Official reference explicitly states API is publicly available and free to use however you wish. Default lookup is the ARRL club station, not an individual customer.

name: ChEBI
freeEvidence: Official ChEBI Licensing section states database is freely accessible and available to anyone under CC BY 4.0. EMBL-EBI terms allow public service interfaces, with fair use and source rights preserved.

name: Finnish Meteorological Institute
freeEvidence: Official FMI documentation explicitly provides machine-readable interface downloads free of charge. Use the open data licence and source attribution; this reads one location and one variable.

name: MedlinePlus
freeEvidence: Official NLM webservice is free of charge and requires neither registration nor licensing. Credit MedlinePlus.gov, avoid implying endorsement, stay below 85 requests/minute and cache daily data.

name: Hong Kong Obervatory
freeEvidence: Official Hong Kong open-data terms allow free commercial and non-commercial download and redistribution. Attribute HKO, DATA.GOV.HK and government ownership; weather measurements are provisional.

name: Gene Ontology API
freeEvidence: Gene Ontology Consortium data and data products are openly available under CC BY 4.0. Preserve creator, source, licence and release attribution; read-only public term API requires no key.

name: Human Protein Atlas
freeEvidence: Official licence encourages research and commercial use under CC BY 4.0. Cite Human Protein Atlas, the gene URL, version and relevant primary publication; preserve third-party data licence constraints.

name: Eurostat API
freeEvidence: Official Eurostat API guide explicitly grants free-of-charge programmatic access to statistical data and metadata and describes this interface for automated queries/downloads. Cite Eurostat as the data source.
